In this module you make a website and look at it in your browser.

## Goals

::: {.objectives title="By the end of this module" duration="20 min"}

- Make a website project.
- Preview the website in a browser.
- Change the title of a page.

:::

## Make the project

Run this command in a terminal.
It makes the folder `my-site` with the files of a small website.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto create project website my-site
```

Then go into the folder.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ cd my-site
```

## Preview the site

Start the preview.
Quarto prints the address of the site, and the browser updates each time you save a file.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto preview
Watching files for changes
Browse at http://localhost:4444/
```

Open the address in your browser.
Leave the terminal open while you work.
